Messages.Author: Marco Wong
Messages.Body:
Dear all,
Today I have played a blood borthers' deck, with the following questions
encountered:

1) Could I use Jerry's special ability to transfer blood to my brothers in
the uncontrolled region?

2) One of my brothers has no blood at the beginning of my minion phase,
could I take unwholesome bond as an action instead of hunting?

Jerry
Clan: Blood Brothers
Capacity: 5
Sabbat
Group: 2
Ability: Chicago Circle : During your master phase, you may move any amount
of blood from the Blood Brothers in the Chicago Circle to any other Blood
Brothers in this circle. Sterile.
Set(s): *Bloodlines
Disciplines :
Inferior Celerity
Inferior Fortitude
Inferior Potence
Superior Sanguinus

Unwholesome bond
Card Text:

+1 stealth action
san: This vampire gains X+1 blood, where X is the number of ready, untapped
Blood Brothers of the same circle as the acting vampire.

SAN: Add 1 blood from the blood bank to each Blood Brother in your
uncontrolled region of the same circle as the acting vampire

Thanks for your help.
Best wishes,
Marco Wong

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 7 Sep 2003 22:55:29 +0800, "Marco Wong"
<h99x...@hkusua.hku.hk> wrote:

> 1) Could I use Jerry's special ability to transfer blood to my brothers in
>the uncontrolled region?

No.

You cannot affect vampires in the uncontrolled region without explicit
card text allowing it. Jerry's ability does not explicity mention
vampires in the uncontrolled region so the cannot affect them.

Rulebook section 1.6.1.5 definition of Targets.

"Vampires in the torpor region are eligible targets by default, but
vampires in the uncontrolled region and contested cards are not."

> 2) One of my brothers has no blood at the beginning of my minion phase,
>could I take unwholesome bond as an action instead of hunting?

No.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

See the online rulebook for this quote from section 6.

"For example, a ready vampire with no blood must hunt."

See also 6.1.2 definition of Hunt action.

"Note that a ready vampire with no blood must hunt (and cannot take
any action except the hunt action)."

There are no other actions that ready vampire can take as long as it
has 0 blood.

The only exception is if you have played a card with that vampire this
turn that prohibits it from hunting (or hunting again) like Change of
Target on a previous hunt attempt. It still cannot take any other
actions, but it can stay untapped.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com

Messages.Author: Ulugh Beg II
Messages.Body:
> Dear all,
> Today I have played a blood borthers' deck, with the following
questions
> encountered:
>
> 1) Could I use Jerry's special ability to transfer blood to my
brothers
in
> the uncontrolled region?

I was about to say no, but I'm not sure now, since it lacks the word
ready or "in
your controlled region".
So, my guess from that card text is yes, although I'm quite sure, you're
not
supposed to. I can't find any rule that backs that up. I'm sure someone
else can.

> 2) One of my brothers has no blood at the beginning of my minion
phase,
> could I take unwholesome bond as an action instead of hunting?

You must hunt. If, at any time, one of your vampires is untapped, ready
and
has no blood, he's forced to hunt before you take any other actions.
Similarly you can't use fifth tradition to add 4 blood to an empty
vampire
before it has to hunt.
Hunting actions are always handled before any other actions.

I personally believe cards like unwholesomebond and restoration should
say
something to the extent of: "hunt, if succesfull gain 2 extra blood from
the
blood bank."
I'm sure there's a good reason why the cards say differently.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
The Lasombra wrote:

> <Timlagor...@yahoo.com> wrote:
>>Suppose you have a vampire in this stuck position where it can't do
>>anything. If it subsequently gains a blood (eg 5th Tradition) can it
>>then act or did it's failure to hunt when it had to paralyse it for that
>>turn? (my guess is that it can act but I'm not sure)
>
> After receiving blood from any source, if it is untapped, it may then
> act, and take any action allowed by cards in play or cards in hand.

Correct. Becoming stuck is not an event; being stuck is a state. Remove
the condition for that state and you are no longer in that state.
